1.explanation:
1. OverflowMenu/OverflowMenu.mdx: the foundational menu component and trigger pattern that context menus will extend.
2. OverflowMenuItem/migrate-to-7.x.md: details menu item states (disabled, selected, nested) and keyboard shortcut support.
3. Popover/Popover.mdx: governs overlay positioning and portal behavior critical to rendering the menu at cursor coordinates.
4. Dropdown/Dropdown.mdx: demonstrates styling, grouping and iconography in menu options similar to context‐menu items.
5. UIShell/UIShell.mdx: covers the side navigation/tree structure shown in the first screenshot, where the context menu is invoked on tree items.
6. DataTable/DataTable.mdx: illustrates file listing rows like the Box example, providing context on row selection and event handling for right‐click actions.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshots demonstrate a custom context‐menu pattern across multiple data‐intensive UIs: a nested tree (side nav) with folder and file items; file lists in a Box‐like DataTable; a spreadsheet grid; code editors and text areas; and a Slack‐style sidebar—all invoking a right‐click context‐menu overlay. Key elements include: the triggering surface (tree items, rows, cells, text blocks, icons); the overlay panel (absolute positioning, keyboard/shortcut hints, nested submenus, selection indicators, disabled states); and the relationship to existing overflow/dropdown patterns.
